title: TypeScript SDK: bidirectional bridge/handover shim for AsyncIterator <-> Web Streams interop
creator: Ariana Chen
acceptance_criteria:
1) Implementation merged and covered by unit tests (concurrency, cancellation, retry, resume token)
2) Integration test with simulated resume tokens and transient failures passes in CI
3) Documentation with examples for both consumer styles published
4) Benchmark results attached showing acceptable overhead
5) Migration guide for existing SDK users added
comments: 2025-02-14 - Ariana Chen: Ticket created; initial proposal drafted. Flagging for ENG streaming working group. Assigned to Luis for design + prototyping.

2025-02-18 - Luis Mendoza: Held design sync with runtime team. Agreed to use sequence ids + resumeToken envelope model. Runtime to add optional resumeToken in transport metadata (runtime task ENG-61023).

2025-02-21 - Luis Mendoza: Prototype implemented (local branch). Verified basic async iterator -> transport flow and cancellation propagation. Found an issue: ReadableStream desiredSize can be negative in some polyfills; added guard to clamp to 0.

2025-02-24 - PM review (Sofia Patel): Confirmed customer scenarios: web clients need ReadableStream example, server-side SDK examples use for-await-of. OK to proceed. Requested clear opt-in for idempotent retries.
2025-02-26 - Design review (Nora Gupta): Reviewed API signatures. Suggested renaming resumeFrom -> applyResumeToken for clarity. Luis pushed updated names in prototype branch.

2025-03-01 - Performance run: stress test with dual consumers (for-await-of + ReadableStream) peak mem ~12MB per stream; within target with highWaterMark=8. 99th percentile latency +1.4% compared to baseline. Added performance note in docs.
2025-03-02 - Luis Mendoza: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ts/pull/2897 for initial implementation, tests, and docs. Requesting reviews from @ariana, @nora, @runtime-team.

2025-03-03 - QA (Diego Ramos): Found flake when consumer aborts during in-flight retry backoff; added repro case and suggested adding deterministic cancellation during backoff window. Luis will patch next.
2025-03-03 - Next steps: fix backoff cancel flake, address naming feedback in PR, add final integration test against streaming-test-server, then move to In Review.
